description: ITIL priority = f(impact, urgency). Impact: 1 High (many users / business service down), 2 Medium (department / degraded), 3 Low (single user). Urgency: 1 High (work stopped), 2 Medium (workaround exists), 3 Low.
overrides: VIP caller: raise by one level, minimum P3, always human review
Security suspicion: route SECOPS, always human review
